intro: The Sack of Murloc Heads is a gruesome bundle collected along the beaches of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Assembled as proof of military action against local shore pests, it is pawned off by Lieutenant Farren Orinelle onto passing adventurers for delivery to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.

p: Southshore stands under constant siege from Syndicate outlaws, Forsaken skirmishers, and wild murlocs crowding the coast. To secure funding and favor from town leadership, local officers must demonstrate that coastal threats are actively being culled. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle gathers proof in the form of severed heads, but the distasteful nature of the cargo—and his own squeamishness—prompts him to hand the dripping sack off to travelers rather than deliver the grisly evidence to Marshal Redpath himself.
